title: Audit Select filter visual depth
description: Audit Select for native/custom select variants, dropdown styling limits, placeholder, icons, multi-select feasibility, states, and field binding.
objective: Define how professional Select controls should work without pretending native select styling can do everything.
acceptance_criteria: The audit distinguishes native select capabilities from custom dropdown work.
The audit covers placeholder, arrow icon, height, typography, padding, border, radius, focus, disabled, and long option behavior.
The audit identifies whether multi-select is in scope or should remain a separate type.
The audit ties select options to option parsing and field binding.
verification: Source-backed findings cite render, CSS, JS, and control IDs.
No Select implementation is made by this task.

budgets.context_budget: select audit, render, CSS, option parsing

risks: Native select controls can become the visual weak point if their browser limits are ignored.
